recipes.name: Green Goddess Salad Dressing
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a small food processor or blender.
Blend until smooth. Taste test and adjust seasoning to taste.
Pour the dressing over your favourite salad or nourish bowl, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † For us, 1 lemon yielded about 2 Tbsp (30 mL) lemon juice. † White miso, also called "Shiro Miso," is fermented for less time than red miso, which gives it a milder, sweeter flavour. If substituting red miso, use a smaller amount and adjust to taste, as red miso is saltier and stronger.
Storage Store well-sealed in the fridge for up to 3 days.
